method: Cross-process CLI integration test plus adapter-level cancellation tests

scenario.signal: cancel_requested event polled by the active worker

processStop.mechanism: Windows Job Object abort via supervisor stdin

scenario.restartPath: a pending cancellation is honored after verified worker restart

adapterCoverage.supervisedCommand: AbortSignal stops the Job Object before the adapter returns
adapterCoverage.openCode: AbortSignal is passed to the supervisor and returns cancelled
adapterCoverage.codex: turn/interrupt is called and the App Server is closed

limitations: Cancellation depends on a running Worker polling the cancellation event.
A hung Worker requires a future timeout and forced-reclaim path.
Unknown usage keeps its budget hold pending.
The Codex adapter has cooperative turn interruption, not a Windows Job Object stop receipt.
reproduction: bun test src/cli.test.ts --test-name-pattern "cancels an active supervised"
